missingPolicy: Unresolved and invalid observations remain in the fixed enrollment prefix. Coverage >=95%; for conservative paired Brier interval, each unresolved/invalid observation contributes +1 (worst possible difference). Never filter the cohort based on accuracy, EV or outcome.
selection: Same per-market v8 candidates and weights; no re-selection after 249 outcomes. New future matches only, first registration immutable, fixed chronological prefix per checkpoint. Order candidates by SHA256(study:event_id); no EV filter.
features: At capture use only results available strictly before capture, with >=30 prior matches/player. Unlike retrospective v8 frozen previous-day context, this prospective study updates historical covariates causally at each capture; same frozen feature implementation.
confirmation: Bonferroni family-wise intervals across 14 targets and 4 planned checkpoints, 3 calendar-day moving-block bootstrap. Compare against the causal competition reference saved at capture. Require Brier improvement beyond adjusted interval, better log loss, ECE<0.08, >=14 observed calendar days, coverage>=95%, fixed prefix closed >=7 days after latest scheduled kickoff.
limits: No winner-model replacement or automatic activation of markets
Statistical score validation is not evidence of EV or profitability: no executable market odds captured for these targets
Source-reported results and closing times, not independently certified official scores
Previous 249 cases remain exploratory and are excluded from this new prospective cohort
No guarantee that any candidate will pass; at 3000 cases or end of study report inconclusive/failure rather than extend until significant
